title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
U.S. Department of Justice
       O f f i c e  o f  t h e  S o l i c i t o r  G e n e r a l




       Washington, D.C. 20530

       October 23, 2025

Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543

  Re:  United States v. A li Danial Hemani, No. 24-1234

Dear Mr. Harris:

 The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned case was granted on October 20,
2025, and petitioner’s opening brief is currently due on December 4, 2025.

Because of the press of other cases, the parties respectfully request, under this Court’s Rule
30.4, that the time within which to  file petitioner’s brie f (and the joint appe ndix) be extended to
and including December 12, 2025, and that the time within which to file respondent’s brief be
extended to and including January 20, 2026.  If those extensions are granted, the reply brief would
be due on February 19, 2026.

 Both parties consent to  this briefing schedule.


      S i n c e r e l y ,



      D. John Sauer
      S o l i c i t o r  G e n e r a l
